```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def get_data(
    add_perc: float = 0.03,
    n_years: int = 20,
    seed: int | None = None,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    local_rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    add_true = 0.03
    gross_margin = 0.8
    beg_cash = 1500.0
    beg_se = 1500.0
    div_payout = 1.0
    mean_sale = 1000.0
    sd_sale = 100.0
    rho = 0.9

    sale_err = local_rng.normal(0.0, sd_sale, n_years)
    sales = np.empty(n_years, dtype=float)
    sales[0] = mean_sale + sale_err[0]
    for i in range(1, n_years):
        sales[i] = (
            mean_sale + rho * (sales[i - 1] - mean_sale) + sale_err[i]
        )

    cogs = (1 - gross_margin) * sales
    ar = sales.copy()
    add = add_perc * sales

    writeoffs = np.full(n_years, np.nan)
    collect = np.full(n_years, np.nan)
    div = np.full(n_years, np.nan)
    se = np.full(n_years, np.nan)
    ni = np.full(n_years, np.nan)
    bde = np.full(n_years, np.nan)
    cash = np.full(n_years, np.nan)

    writeoffs[0] = 0.0
    collect[0] = 0.0
    bde[0] = add[0]
    ni[0] = sales[0] - cogs[0] - bde[0]
    div[0] = ni[0] * div_payout
    cash[0] = beg_cash + collect[0] - cogs[0] - div[0]
    se[0] = beg_se + ni[0] - div[0]

    for i in range(1, n_years):
        writeoffs[i] = add_true * ar[i - 1]
        collect[i] = (1 - add_true) * ar[i - 1]
        bde[i] = add[i] - add[i - 1] + writeoffs[i]
        ni[i] = sales[i] - cogs[i] - bde[i]
        div[i] = ni[i] * div_payout
        cash[i] = cash[i - 1] + collect[i] - cogs[i] - div[i]
        se[i] = se[i - 1] + ni[i] - div[i]

    return pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "year": np.arange(1, n_years + 1, dtype=np.int64),
            "add_perc": np.repeat(add_perc, n_years),
            "sales": sales,
            "writeoffs": writeoffs,
            "collect": collect,
            "div": div,
            "se": se,
            "ni": ni,
            "bde": bde,
            "cash": cash,
            "cogs": cogs,
            "ar": ar,
            "add": add,
        }
    )


def run_simulation(i: int, add_perc: float) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return get_data(add_perc=add_perc, seed=2021 + i)


df_1000 = get_data(n_years=1000, seed=2021)

rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)
add_percs = rng.uniform(low=0.01, high=0.05, size=5000)

res_list = [
    run_simulation(i, add_perc)
    for i, add_perc in enumerate(add_percs, start=1)
]

res_df = pl.concat(
    [
        df.with_columns(id=pl.lit(i, dtype=pl.Int32))
        for i, df in enumerate(res_list, start=1)
    ],
    how="vertical",
).select("id", pl.exclude("id"))

def get_coefs(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    fm_data = (
        df
        .sort("year")
        .with_columns(lag_ni=pl.col("ni").shift(1))
        .drop_nulls("lag_ni")
    )
    x = fm_data["lag_ni"].to_numpy()
    y = fm_data["ni"].to_numpy()
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x])
    beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0]
    return pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "add_perc": [df["add_perc"].mean()],
            "persistence": [beta[1]],
        }
    )

results = pl.concat(
    [
        get_coefs(df).with_columns(id=pl.lit(i, dtype=pl.Int32))
        for i, df in enumerate(res_list, start=1)
    ],
    how="vertical",
).select("id", pl.exclude("id"))
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
funda = load_parquet("funda", "comp")
company = load_parquet("company", "comp")
ccmxpf_lnkhist = load_parquet("ccmxpf_lnkhist", "crsp")
msf = load_parquet("msf", "crsp")

sics = (
    company
    .select("gvkey", "sic")
    .with_columns(sic=pl.col("sic").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False))
)

funda_mod = (
    funda
    .filter(
        pl.col("indfmt") == "INDL",
        pl.col("datafmt") == "STD",
        pl.col("consol") == "C",
        pl.col("popsrc") == "D",
    )
    .join(sics, on="gvkey", how="left")
    .with_columns(sic=pl.coalesce("sich", "sic"))
)

acc_data_raw = (
    funda_mod
    .filter(
        pl.col("at").is_not_null(),
        pl.col("pddur") == 12,
        pl.col("exchg").is_in([11, 12]),
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("sic").is_between(6000, 6999).alias("finance"),
        pl.col("che", "dlc", "txp").fill_null(0),
    )
    .sort("gvkey", "datadate")
    .drop("ca")
    .rename({"act": "ca", "che": "cash", "lct": "cl",
             "dlc": "std", "txp": "tp"})
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("at") + pl.col("at").shift(1).over("gvkey"))
        .truediv(2).alias("avg_at"),
        pl.col("ca", "cash", "cl", "std", "tp")
        .diff().over("gvkey").name.prefix("d_")
    )
    .select(
        "gvkey", "datadate", "fyear", "avg_at", "at",
        "oiadp", "dp", "finance", "d_ca", "d_cash",
        "d_cl", "d_std", "d_tp", "sic", "pddur",
    )
    .with_columns(
        acc_raw=(
            (pl.col("d_ca") - pl.col("d_cash"))
             - (pl.col("d_cl") - pl.col("d_std") - pl.col("d_tp"))
             - pl.col("dp")
        )
    )
    .filter(
        pl.col("fyear").is_between(1962, 1991),
        pl.col("avg_at") > 0,
    )
)

acc_data = (
    acc_data_raw
    .with_columns(
        earn=pl.col("oiadp") / pl.col("avg_at"),
        acc=pl.col("acc_raw") / pl.col("avg_at"),
    )
    .with_columns(cfo=pl.col("earn") - pl.col("acc"))
    .sort(["gvkey", "datadate"])
    .with_columns(lead_earn=pl.col("earn").shift(-1).over("gvkey"))
    .filter(~pl.col("finance"), pl.col("acc").is_not_null())
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("acc", "earn", "cfo", "lead_earn")
        .era.ntile(10).name.suffix("_decile"),
        sic2=(
            pl.col("sic").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False)
            .cast(pl.Utf8).str.slice(0, 2)
        ),
    )
)

ccm_link = (
    ccmxpf_lnkhist
    .filter(
        pl.col("linktype").is_in(["LC", "LU", "LS"]),
        pl.col("linkprim").is_in(["C", "P"]),
    )
    .rename({"lpermno": "permno"})
    .with_columns(
        linkenddt=pl.col("linkenddt")
                  .fill_null(pl.col("linkenddt").max())
    )
    .select("gvkey", "permno", "linkdt", "linkenddt")
)

crsp_link = (
    acc_data_raw
    .select("gvkey", "datadate")
    .join(ccm_link, on="gvkey", how="inner")
    .filter(
        pl.col("datadate").is_between(pl.col("linkdt"),
                                      pl.col("linkenddt"))
    )
    .select("gvkey", "datadate", "permno")
    .with_columns(
        start_month=
            pl.col("datadate").dt.offset_by("4mo")
            .dt.truncate("1mo"),
        end_month=
            pl.col("datadate").dt.offset_by("15mo")
            .dt.truncate("1mo"),
        month=pl.col("datadate")
            .dt.truncate("1mo"),
    )
)

crsp_data = (
    msf
    .join(crsp_link, on="permno", how="inner")
    .filter(
        pl.col("date").is_between(pl.col("start_month"),
                                  pl.col("end_month"))
    )
    .group_by("gvkey", "permno", "datadate")
    .agg(
        ret=(
            pl.when(pl.col("ret").count() > 0)
            .then(pl.col("ret").drop_nulls().add(1).product() - 1)
            .otherwise(None)
        ),
        n_months=pl.len(),
    )
)

size_rets = get_size_rets_monthly()

me_breakpoints = get_me_breakpoints()

crsp_dates = (
    msf
    .select("date")
    .unique()
    .with_columns(month=pl.col("date").dt.truncate("1mo"))
)

me_values = (
    crsp_link
    .join(crsp_dates, on="month", how="inner")
    .join(msf, on=["permno", "date"], how="inner")
    .with_columns(mktcap=pl.col("prc").abs() * pl.col("shrout") / 1000)
    .select("permno", "datadate", "month", "mktcap")
)

me_decile_assignments = (
    me_breakpoints
    .join(me_values, on="month", how="inner")
    .filter(pl.col("mktcap").is_between("me_min", "me_max",
                                        closed="left"))
    .select("permno", "datadate", "decile")
)

cum_size_rets = (
    me_decile_assignments
    .select("datadate", "decile")
    .unique()
    .with_columns(
        start_month=(
            pl.col("datadate").dt.offset_by("4mo").dt.truncate("1mo")
        ),
        end_month=(
            pl.col("datadate").dt.offset_by("15mo")
        ).dt.truncate("1mo"),
    )
    .join(size_rets, on="decile", how="inner")
    .filter(
        pl.col("month").is_between(
            pl.col("start_month"), pl.col("end_month"), closed="both"
        )
    )
    .group_by("datadate", "decile")
    .agg(
        pl.col("ew_ret").add(1).product() - 1,
        pl.col("vw_ret").add(1).product() - 1,
        pl.len().alias("n_size_months"),
    )
)

size_adj_rets = (
    crsp_data
    .join(me_decile_assignments, on=["permno", "datadate"], how="inner")
    .join(cum_size_rets, on=["datadate", "decile"], how="inner")
    .with_columns(size_adj_ret=pl.col("ret") - pl.col("vw_ret"))
    .select(
        "gvkey", "datadate", "size_adj_ret",
        "n_months", "n_size_months"
    )
)

reg_data = (
    acc_data
    .join(size_adj_rets,
          on=["gvkey", "datadate"], how="inner"
    )
    .collect()
)

fm_earn = pf.feols("lead_earn ~ earn", data=reg_data)
fm_earn_decile = pf.feols("lead_earn_decile ~ earn_decile", data=reg_data)

def run_table_ind(
    sic2: str,
    lhs: str = "lead_earn",
    rhs: str = "earn",
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df = reg_data.filter(pl.col("sic2") == sic2)
    fm = smf.ols(f"{lhs} ~ {rhs}", data=df.to_pandas()).fit()
    params = {name: float(value) for name, value in fm.params.items()}
    return pl.DataFrame(
        {"sic2": [sic2], **{key: [value] for key, value in params.items()}}
    )

def stats_for_table(x: pl.Series) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "mean": [x.mean()],
            "q1": [x.quantile(0.25)],
            "median": [x.quantile(0.50)],
            "q3": [x.quantile(0.75)],
        }
    )

def summ_for_table(
    lhs: str = "lead_earn",
    rhs: str = "earn",
    digits: int = 3,
) -> GT:
    coefs = pl.concat(
        [
            run_table_ind(sic2, lhs=lhs, rhs=rhs)
            for sic2 in reg_data["sic2"].unique().sort()
        ],
        how="vertical",
    ).drop("sic2")
    summ = (
        pl.concat(
            [
                stats_for_table(coefs[col]).with_columns(term=pl.lit(col))
                for col in coefs.columns
            ],
            how="vertical",
        )
        .select("term", "mean", "q1", "median", "q3")
    )
    return summ.style.fmt_number(
        columns=["mean", "q1", "median", "q3"], decimals=digits
    )

fm_acc = pf.feols("lead_earn ~ acc + cfo", data=reg_data)
fm_acc_decile = pf.feols(
    "lead_earn_decile ~ acc_decile + cfo_decile",
    data=reg_data,
)

mms = [
    pf.feols("size_adj_ret ~ lead_earn + acc + cfo", data=reg_data),
    pf.feols(
        "size_adj_ret ~ lead_earn_decile + acc_decile + cfo_decile",
        data=reg_data,
    ),
]

mm0_tidy = pl.from_pandas(mms[0].tidy().reset_index())
fm_acc_tidy = pl.from_pandas(fm_acc.tidy().reset_index())

beta_hat = (
    mm0_tidy.filter(pl.col("Coefficient") == "lead_earn")
    .select("Estimate")
    .item()
)
beta_gamma_hat = (
    -mm0_tidy.filter(pl.col("Coefficient") == "acc")
    .select("Estimate")
    .item()
)
gamma_star_hat = beta_gamma_hat / beta_hat
gamma_hat = (
    fm_acc_tidy.filter(pl.col("Coefficient") == "acc")
    .select("Estimate")
    .item()
)
beta_gamma_implied = beta_hat * gamma_hat

eff = [
    pf.feols("size_adj_ret ~ acc + cfo", data=reg_data),
    pf.feols("size_adj_ret ~ acc_decile + cfo_decile", data=reg_data),
]

portfolio_rets = (
    reg_data
    .group_by("fyear", "acc_decile")
    .agg(size_adj_ret=pl.col("size_adj_ret").mean())
)

fm_tbl6 = smf.ols(
    "size_adj_ret ~ C(acc_decile) - 1",
    data=portfolio_rets.to_pandas(),
).fit()

hedge_data = (
    portfolio_rets
    .with_columns(acc_decile_str=pl.col("acc_decile").cast(pl.Utf8))
    .filter(pl.col("acc_decile_str").is_in(["1", "10"]))
    .with_columns(
        low_accrual=(pl.col("acc_decile_str") == "1").cast(pl.Int8)
    )
)
fm_tbl6_hedge = smf.ols(
    "size_adj_ret ~ low_accrual",
    data=hedge_data.to_pandas(),
).fit()
hedge_ret = float(fm_tbl6_hedge.params["low_accrual"])
p_val = float(fm_tbl6_hedge.pvalues["low_accrual"])
```

```{python}
    reg_data_deciles
    .filter(pl.col("ni_decile").is_in([1, 10]))
    .group_by("ni_decile", "year")
    .agg(ni=pl.col("ni").mean())
    .with_columns(ni_decile=pl.col("ni_decile").cast(pl.Utf8))
    .sort(["ni_decile", "year"])
    .ggplot()
    .aes(x="year", y="ni", group="ni_decile", color="ni_decile")
    .geom_line()
)
```
